primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: Bun creates the source-controlled text lockfile bun.lock, and its lockfile should be committed as local dependency resolution evidence.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: The local gate reads existing bun.lock only, recognizes the text lockfile structure, and avoids running bun install or dependency installers.

primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: A bill of materials represents component inventory plus direct and transitive dependency relationships as machine-readable evidence.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: The local gate writes an SBOM-shaped lockfile package inventory and relationship list while blocking official CycloneDX compliance claims.

primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: SPDX is an open standard for SBOM-style software package exchange, with current and previous document formats published as specifications.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: The local gate preserves package/version/integrity fields but does not claim official SPDX document compliance or license conclusions.

primarySourceInputs.observedPattern: GitHub exposes dependency graph and repository SBOM endpoints as hosted repository supply-chain evidence.
primarySourceInputs.localAbsorption: The local gate records that no GitHub API or hosted SBOM export was performed, leaving hosted parity as a protected future boundary.

claimBoundary: Lockfile SBOM quality is local no-provider inventory evidence only. It does not claim official SPDX/CycloneDX compliance, hosted SBOM export, dependency graph parity, vulnerability-free status, license compliance, release readiness, production readiness, public readiness, external validation, or autonomous reliability.

sbomQualityChecks.label: Bun text lockfile structure is recognized
lockfile version is current expected local format
root workspace dependencies match package manifest count
lockfile inventory covers every direct manifest dependency
lockfile inventory captures transitive package surface
lockfile package records include version and integrity metadata
inventory JSONL has one record per lockfile package
inventory JSONL is parseable and hash-addressed
official SBOM and hosted validation claims remain blocked
sbomQualityChecks.detail: CycloneDX/SPDX/GitHub Dependency Graph parity flags are false
